verdict.rationale: Khoj documents official web and desktop apps that go beyond basic chat. The desktop app syncs shared files and folders, it can install as a progressive web app, and voice chat works on web, desktop and Obsidian. WhatsApp also offers slash commands such as /dream image generation. There is no documented native mobile app, and nothing shows feature parity across surfaces. missing for 10: an official native mobile app, documented cross-surface feature parity (e.g., automations, agents and code execution on each app), independent hands-on corroboration of the apps.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics

citations.quote: Access it from your Emacs, Obsidian, the Khoj desktop app, or any web browser
Share your files, folders with Khoj using the app. Khoj will keep these files in sync to provide contextual responses when you search or chat.
You can also install the Khoj application on your desktop as a progressive web app.
You can use voice chat on the web, Desktop, and Obsidian apps.
Without any desktop clients, you can start chatting with Khoj on WhatsApp.
/dream: Generate an image in response to your prompt.
